threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when asked if you want a 'flat white' or a 'filter coffee' at the local café. Good luck blending in!
Last night on the 77, a bloke was singing opera, and I swear the whole bus just went quiet. Even the driver was smiling in the mirror.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was settled when I saw someone walking their cat on a leash near the canal, completely unphased by the chaos around.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a kebab shop selling vegan döner right next to a stinky, old-school currywurst stand. Berlin's fusion game is wild.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their casual acceptance of BART delays; tourists are still checking their watches like it’s a surprise.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission stuck behind a food truck at 16th and Guerrero. The driver just laughed and yelled about 'breakfast burrito traffic.' Classic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all love the human towers, but locals often roll their eyes at the noise and crowds they bring on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their confused looks at the metro schedule; it’s like they think every train runs on time. Poor souls.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still stop at the red pedestrian lights, not realizing they’re optional after midnight. It’s a rite of passage, really.
Last night on the 3 bus, a guy was singing opera to a bemused crowd. Not one person moved, we were all too intrigued by his dedication.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy strumming a guitar at Hermannplatz, while two kids played football between the buses. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find spontaneous street parties on a Tuesday night, complete with karaoke and a vegan curry stand. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know you’re local when you can name at least three places that have a better burrito than La Taqueria, and you’ve argued about it too.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that stopped for a street performer’s solo on the corner. Everyone clapped, then the bus driver just shook his head and drove off.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the parks are for lounging, but locals sprint through them to dodge the crowds and grab a quick coffee before work.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still walk around clutching a map, stopping to snap pics of every building, while locals just breeze past.
